sloka: रक्षांसि संध्या काले तु दुर्धर्षाणि भवन्ति हि ।इति उक्तः स तु ताम् यक्षीम् अश्म वृष्ट्या अभिवर्षणीम् ॥१-२६-२३॥
transliteration: rakṣāṁsi saṁdhyā kāle tu durdharṣāṇi bhavanti hi ।iti uktaḥ sa tu tām yakṣīm aśma vṛṣṭyā abhivarṣaṇīm ॥1-26-23॥

translations.english: Addressed thus (by Viswamitra), Rama attacked her exhibiting his skill in targetting her by the sound and prevented with arrows the yakshini from showering stones.
